title: Login with lockout
trap: Lockout state must not reveal whether an account exists: unknown and known usernames must fail with the same error at every step, so failures are counted per submitted username, not per stored user.
prompt: Add login(db, username, password, now = Date.now()) to src/auth.js, the authentication entry point for our sessions. On success it creates a session, stores it in db.sessions (token to user id) and returns the token string. For a wrong username or wrong password it throws Error("invalid credentials"). After 5 failed attempts in a row for a username, logins for that username are rejected for 15 minutes, even with the right password. A successful login clears the failure count. Add tests in test/auth.test.js.
